app.title: Microsoft killed FoxPro in 2007. Anyway, here's FoxPro revived
app.author: boredjohnny
app.description: A revived FoxPro interpreter/runtime that brings the classic dBase/Clipper-style language back to modern platforms, providing a command-line REPL and script execution environment.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository or download the release archive.
Run the binary with a simple 'Hello, World!' FoxPro script and verify output.
Compile a small program using the provided compiler and execute it.
Test the interpreter’s support for basic file I/O and SQL queries against a sample database.
Measure the execution time of a small benchmark script to compare with the original FoxPro performance.
